Terms.

Version 1.0 · Effective 3 November 2026

These are the terms for every reel-editing order placed directly with me. They are the same for everyone, so you know what you are agreeing to before you pay. Only the deliverables change, and those are written on your invoice.

The short version

  • You pay 50% to start and 50% on delivery. Invoices are due in 3 days.
  • The 50% you start with is not refundable.
  • You get 2 rounds of changes per reel. If you do not reply within 3 days of delivery, the reels count as approved.
  • You own the reels once you have paid in full. I may show them in my portfolio.
  • You confirm you have the right to use the footage and music you send me.
  • There is a paid trial of 3 reels for ₹2,400, with ₹1,200 to start. Read the trial terms.
  • If we disagree, we talk first. After that, the courts in Chennai.

About these terms

I am S. Kenisha Khatri, an individual freelance video editor based in Chennai, India. “I” and “me” mean me. “You” means the person or business that orders from me.

These terms apply to every order you place with me directly. If we work through a marketplace such as Upwork, that platform’s own terms apply instead.

Accepting these terms

Before work starts I send you an order summary with the deliverables, the price and a link to this page. You accept these terms, in the version named on your invoice, by doing any one of these:

  • replying “Agreed” to my order summary;
  • paying an invoice; or
  • sending me footage after I have sent the summary.

Messages, invoices and payment records are kept as proof of what we agreed. If I change these terms, the change applies only to orders accepted after the new version date.

The order

I make short-form vertical reels. I do not currently offer long-form video editing.

Your invoice lists what you are buying: the number of reels, the languages for captions, and anything extra. Anything not listed is not included. Posting, scheduling, scripts, thumbnails and shooting are quoted separately.

Delivery times start when I have both your first payment and all of your footage. Packages are delivered within 72 hours, and the paid trial within 24 hours.

Payment

  • 50% to start, 50% on delivery. I begin work after the first 50% and your footage arrive. The second 50% is due when I deliver.
  • Invoices are due 3 days after the invoice date, in rupees, by UPI to the details shown on the invoice.
  • Late payment: a fee of 2% of the invoice amount is added for every 3 days it is late, up to a total of 10% of that invoice. I pause work on your order while a payment is overdue.
  • Tax: I do not charge GST at present. If I become required to, it is added to orders accepted after that date. If you must deduct TDS, tell me before paying, send me the TDS certificate afterwards, and ask me for my PAN.

Deposit and cancelling

  • The first 50% is not refundable once paid, because it reserves my time and starts the work.
  • If you cancel after work has started, reels I have already delivered stay yours once paid for. If their value is more than your deposit, you pay the difference. The second 50% is not charged for reels I have not delivered.
  • If you go silent for 14 days, I may close the order and give your slot to someone else. The deposit stays with me and nothing further is owed for undelivered reels.

Paid trial

The trial lets you test my work before choosing a plan. The same terms apply, with these differences:

  • Price: 3 reels at ₹800 each, ₹2,400 in all. You start by paying ₹1,200.
  • Delivery: all 3 reels within 24 hours of my receiving the ₹1,200 and one source video of up to 30 minutes. They arrive as watermarked previews for you to review. You may not post them.
  • Changes: 1 round of changes per reel.
  • If you like them and choose a plan: the remaining ₹1,200 is added to the first invoice of your plan. When that is paid I send the clean files. The plan price itself is not reduced.
  • If you do not continue: you owe nothing more and we go our own ways. The ₹1,200 you paid is not refundable, and I keep the watermarked reels and the rights to them. If I have not heard from you within 3 days of delivery, the trial ends.
  • Limit: one trial per client or brand.

Your footage and content

You send me the footage, music and brand material. You confirm that you own it or have permission to use it, including permission from anyone who appears in it and for any music.

If anyone makes a claim because of material you supplied, that is your responsibility and not mine. I may decline content that is unlawful, and I will tell you before starting.

I use AI tools for transcription and cutting assistance, and I check every reel myself. Your footage is used only to make your reels.

Delivery, changes and approval

  • You get 2 rounds of changes per reel. A round is one combined list of changes. Extra rounds, or changes to the brief or footage, are quoted separately.
  • You have 3 days after delivery to send changes or approve. If I hear nothing in that time, the reels count as approved.
  • If you are late with footage or feedback, my deadline moves by the same amount.

Ownership and my portfolio

You own the finished reels once you have paid in full. Until then I keep the rights, and you may not publish them. Your original footage always stays yours.

I may show your finished reels in my portfolio and on my social accounts. If you would rather I did not, tell me in writing before or after delivery and I will leave them out.

Privacy

I keep your unreleased footage and business information private, and you do the same for my rates and methods. I delete your files 30 days after final delivery, so keep your own copies.

No promise of results

I edit the reels. I cannot promise views, followers or sales, because those depend on the platform and the audience. You are responsible for what you post and for following each platform’s rules.

Liability and things outside my control

My total liability for any claim on an order is limited to what you paid for that order. I am not liable for lost income or other indirect losses. Nothing here limits any liability that the law does not allow me to limit.

I am not in breach if something outside my control delays the work, such as illness, power or internet failure, platform outages or natural events. I will tell you promptly and we will agree a new date.

Disputes and the law that applies

Indian law applies. If we disagree, please write to me first and we will try to settle it within 14 days. If that does not work, the courts in Chennai have jurisdiction.
